name: 42276 · Russellville, KY
findings: ZIP 42276 (Russellville) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 42276 (Russellville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 42276 (Russellville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).
